_doc: MANIFEST of which minimality/relaxation clauses are ON in each Alloy model, focused on the FINAL ENUMERATED versions (the models our in-use testsets were generated from). Source of truth for the dashboard. A 'relaxation' here is a perturbation tag (PTag); a clause `all x | secure_speculation_scheme_p[RX->x]` means 'applying perturbation RX to each x individually makes the program secure' = that axis is minimized (every x is individually necessary to the leak). Ground-truthed by reading each .als's gen_useful_litmus block (line numbers cited; verify in the analyzer before editing, they drift).
_generated: 2026-10-26 by alloy-minimality session; extracted from STAGE1_alloy/models/*.als gen_useful_litmus

ptag_legend.RR: make instruction resolved when it previously wasn't (resolve a branch)  [STT_6.als:193]
ptag_legend.RC: make instruction committed when it previously wasn't  [STT_6.als:192]

axis_meaning_when_on.RR: per-branch minimality: each unresolved branch (except first_uncommitted) is individually necessary — resolving it alone => secure. (This is the clause that forbids multi-branch leaks; see MINIMALITY_TAGALONG_FIX.md.)
axis_meaning_when_on.RC: first-uncommitted boundary: the first uncommitted instruction's commit/resolve boundary is necessary.
axis_meaning_when_on.RS: per-state minimality: each architectural state (register/mem) is individually necessary — removing it => secure.
axis_meaning_when_on.RI: instruction-minimality: every instruction is individually necessary — removing it => secure. OFF means non-contributing padding instructions are allowed = 'interleave stage 1' (per Anna's two-stage framing).
axis_meaning_when_on.RO: operand-minimality: every operand is individually necessary — removing it => secure. OFF in all final models. NOTE: when ON (as in STT_6_core) it OVER-PRUNES — combined with no_extra_inst it deletes the br_x-as-gate mechanism (a br_x gate's condition operand is leak-irrelevant => RO rejects it; no_extra_inst forbids a 0-operand br_x => no RO-minimal br_x-gate can exist). See TWO_STAGE_STT_FEASIBILITY.md + claudelog 2026-10-26.
